title: Cosmic Dragon Highway
description: A triptych surreal painting showing three connected scenes: a glowing green and purple spiral galaxy filled with floating mathematical and digital symbols, a silver Cadillac speeding down an orange-lit highway toward a giant glowing Cadillacs billboard under a starry purple sky, and a massive turquoise dragon with golden hair breathing fire beside two Cadillacs on a mechanical platform with gears and a giant clock.
prompt: A vibrant surreal triptych painting. Left panel shows a swirling green and purple galaxy vortex filled with floating mathematical symbols, hearts, letters and icons. Middle panel depicts a sleek silver Cadillac driving fast on a glowing orange highway toward a large illuminated Cadillac billboard in a purple cloudy night sky. Right panel features a giant turquoise Chinese dragon with flowing golden hair and orange eyes breathing orange fire, standing beside a purple and a silver Cadillac on a circular mechanical platform made of gears and clock faces.
